newsitem.title: MOZAMBIQUE: Mozambique police seize radios, hold former rebel.
newsitem.headline: Mozambique police seize radios, hold former rebel.

text.p: Mozambican police have seized sophisticated military radio equipment from an official of the former rebel movement Renamo in the northern city of Nampula, Radio Mozambique said on Monday.

The equipment includes frequency-hopping radios, and is said to be able to cover the entire country. The police have detained Renamo official Fernando Jossias and sent the radio equipment to the country capital Maputo.

A Renamo spokesman in Maputo described the police action as "a Frelimo provocation". Renamo fought a 16-year civil war against the ruling Frelimo government only to lose multi-party elections in 1994.
The spokesman said the radios were used by his party's leadership to keep in contact with Renamo offices throughout the country because the organisation had few faxes or phones.
He added that the government had agreed to replace the radios with civilian equipment, but he said it had never honoured this promise.
